properties.reviewer_role: E01-E08 or independent clearly scoped reviewer
properties.source_pins: array: exact commit SHA and original raw SHA256 or SOURCE_GAP
properties.primary_sources: array: first-party sources with dated version URL/DOI
properties.counterexamples: array: independent fixture, expected vs observed, domain, log hash
properties.independent_run: null unless actual env, version/binary digest, command, exit, timestamp, outputs, witness supplied
properties.open_gates: array: no invented PASS; distinguish HOLD, NOT_RUN, SOURCE_GAP
properties.privacy_review: PASS only if actual scan; never raw IMU/identifiers/secrets/private paths
properties.sha256_manifest: sha256 for submitted original files, computed from actual bytes

return_type: one reviewer one terminal original with negative evidence retained
